en.title: The Galactic Post Office and the Note Borne by a Flying Ship
en.premise: Months have passed since the turmoil of the previous story. At the Tsukuyomi Bookstore, a mysterious model of a "flying ship" has come to be on display. One day, a hidden door within the model reveals an addressless old map and a single letter. Could this be the "secret map" left behind by the legendary airship that once soared through the skies of Hoshimigaoka? As I trace the map's path, I begin to uncover a forgotten promise and the truth behind the gentle lies the townspeople have quietly kept.

zh.title: 银河的邮局与飞船传递的便笺
zh.premise: 距离前作的骚动已过去数月。月读书房里摆放起了一个不可思议的“飞船”模型。某日，从模型的暗门中，发现了一张没有收件人的旧地图和一封信。这或许就是曾经在星见之丘上空翱翔的传说之飞船所留下的“秘密地图”。在追寻地图线索的过程中，我逐渐触及了一个被遗忘的约定，以及镇上人们悄悄隐藏的“温柔谎言”的真相。
